articulo: S5 · W Trek vs O Circuit: How to Choose in Torres del Paine
caption:
The W, the O or day hikes? In Torres del Paine, the right choice is the one that matches the traveler, not the trail with the biggest name.

Three ideas to start with: ask what you want first, be honest about your experience, and remember that day trips from Puerto Natales are a valid way to know the park.

The full guide is on our journal. Link in bio.

#torresdelpaine #patagonia #wtrek #ocircuit #puertonatales

campos.title: W Trek vs O Circuit in Torres del Paine
campos.subtitle: How to choose the route that fits you

campos.title: Start with what you want
campos.body: Before choosing a trail in Torres del Paine, ask how many days you have, how prepared you are, what you most want to see and what budget you work with. The answers usually point to one path.

campos.title: The W is often enough
campos.body: The W takes roughly four or five days. The O is longer and asks for experience walking several days in a row and sleeping in refuges or camping. Without it, the W in Torres del Paine is enough.
campos.alt: Hikers in Torres del Paine, Patagonia, Chile

campos.title: Day hikes are a valid choice
campos.body: Stay in Puerto Natales and visit Torres del Paine on day trips: a town with restaurants, plans that adapt to the weather, and transfers we factor in. Some day hikes are demanding, so match the route to your fitness.
